description: This Java source file defines the class `BeanStreamPayment`, which implements the `PaymentModule` interface to handle payment transactions via the BeanStream payment gateway. It includes methods for initiating, authorizing, capturing, refunding, and processing transactions, with detailed construction of HTTP requests and parsing of responses. The class manages configuration validation and uses external services for logging and utility functions.

classes.name: BeanStreamPayment
classes.description: This class implements payment processing via BeanStream, including transaction initiation, authorization, capture, refund, and response parsing.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Initializes a payment transaction; currently unimplemented, returns null.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Performs an authorization transaction by calling processTransaction with TransactionType.AUTHORIZE.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a pre-authorized transaction, constructs a backend request to BeanStream, and processes the response.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs combined authorization and capture by calling processTransaction with TransactionType.AUTHORIZECAPTURE.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund or void operation depending on parameters, sending a request to BeanStream and handling the response.

methods.name: sendTransaction
methods.description: Constructs and sends an HTTP POST request to BeanStream for processing transactions of various types (purchase, refund, capture) and parses the response.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Handles the creation and sending of a transaction request to BeanStream, including generating order IDs and request parameters.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the response map from BeanStream into an internal Transaction object, including setting relevant transaction details.

methods.name: formatUrlResponse
methods.description: Parses URL-encoded response payload into a key-value map.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the required configuration keys are present in the integration configuration.
